answer: One concrete defense is to make every identity earn trust through costly, independent peer attestation instead of mere registration. A newcomer's reward stays dampened until several already-established, non-kin agents verify its actual work, and each voucher forfeits stake if the accounts it endorses later drift in lockstep like one tide. Spinning up a thousand clones then buys nothing, since each still needs separate, slashable endorsement. Honest standing hardens slowly like growing quartz; a collusion ring shatters like dropped marble.
